scripts.prepare: bash -c 'COMMITHOOKS=${COMMITHOOKS_DIR:-$HOME/Documents/commithooks}; GIT_DIR=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null); [ -d "$COMMITHOOKS/lib" ] && [ -n "$GIT_DIR" ] && for h in pre-commit commit-msg pre-push post-checkout post-merge; do [ -f "$COMMITHOOKS/$h" ] && cp "$COMMITHOOKS/$h" "$GIT_DIR/hooks/$h" && chmod +x "$GIT_DIR/hooks/$h"; done && rm -rf "${GIT_DIR}/lib" && cp -r "$COMMITHOOKS/lib" "$GIT_DIR/lib" || true'
